title: Execution record coordinates
statement: For an execution record $e$, define its eleven coordinates, in order, to be its number of circuit inputs, number of hard-wired input bits, step budget, current instruction, preceding cell of that instruction, first instruction of the current step, step-loop counter, inner-loop counter, position in the hard-wired input, position in the free input, and scratch value.
